claim_validated: The REPCNTS health test treats the configured repetition-count threshold as exclusive rather than inclusive.

observations.name: alternating control
observations.result: Alternating symbols reset the repetition counter and do not produce a failure pulse.

observations.name: subthreshold control
observations.result: A repeated symbol count below threshold does not produce a failure pulse.

observations.name: boundary witness
observations.result: At the configured threshold, the DUT does not assert test_fail_pulse_o.

observations.name: late failure witness
observations.result: The next repeated symbol finally asserts test_fail_pulse_o, proving the implemented boundary is threshold plus one.

determinism_check.result: Both executions completed with PASS BUG013_REPCNTS_OFF_BY_ONE_WITNESS.

security_impact: A repeated or stuck entropy symbol can remain accepted for one configured-threshold boundary sample longer than the configured repetition-count threshold allows. This weakens entropy health-test integrity for the symbol-level REPCNTS path.
